                                                                                
 Usage: agentarts config [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...                            
                                                                                
 Configuration management. (alias: configure)                                   
                                                                                
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --name             -n      <str>  Agent name                                 │
│ --entrypoint       -e      <str>  Agent entrypoint (e.g., app:main)          │
│ --region           -r      <str>  Huawei Cloud region (e.g., cn-southwest-2) │
│ --dependency-file  -d      <str>  Path to dependency file (e.g.,             │
│                                   requirements.txt)                          │
│ --swr-org                  <str>  SWR organization name                      │
│ --swr-repo                 <str>  SWR repository name                        │
│ --help                            Show this message and exit.                │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Commands ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ list         List all configured agents.                                     │
│ set-default  Set the default agent name.                                     │
│ get          Get configuration value or agent details.                       │
│ set          Set configuration value.                                        │
│ remove       Remove an agent configuration.                                  │
│ set-env      Set an environment variable for an agent.                       │
│ remove-env   Remove an environment variable from an agent.                   │
│ list-env     List environment variables for an agent.                        │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
